source: 697 Madam Magician’s Explanation
target: 697 Explicatio Dominae Magicae

source: As Lumian gazed at the peculiar soil, he couldn’t help but recall the scene of Hela retrieving the Samaritan Women’s Spring.
target: Dum Lumian solum insolitum contemplabatur, recordari non potuit scaenam Helae, quae fontem Samaritarum Feminarum recuperabat.

source: After a moment of contemplation, he retrieved gold bars and coins from his Traveler’s Bag and ignited a blazing white fireball in his palm.
target: Post aliquod momentum meditationis, ex sacco viatoris auratae laminae et nummos extraxit et in palma sua globum ignis candidi flagrans accendit.

source: As the flames surged, the gold gradually melted under the control of his spirituality, forming a small golden box.
target: Dum flammas impetu crescere videbantur, aurum paulatim sub imperio eius spiritualis liquefactum est, constituitque parvam arcam auream.

source: Lumian then used the flames as a blade to fashion a cover for the box.
target: Tum Lumian flammas quasi lamina ad tegmen arcae conficiendum adhibuit.

source: Once the gold had cooled and solidified, he used the straight sword as a shovel to transfer the palm‑sized clump of soil into the box before closing the lid.
target: Cum aurum refrigeratum atque solidatum esset, gladium rectum uti trulla ad transferendum agglomeratum soli, cuius magnitudo palmae similis erat, in arcam usus est antequam operculum clauderet.

source: After stowing away the golden box, Lumian noticed that the straight sword in his hand had become rusty and decayed.
target: Arcam auream recondito, Lumian animadvertit gladium rectum in manu eius oxidatum atque corrumpi.

source: Rather than being alarmed, Lumian was delighted. He muttered to himself, “That soil is indeed magical…”
target: Pro timore, Lumian potius laetatus est. Ipse sibi submurmuravit: “Iste solum vere magicum est…”

source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: This was one of his gains from the Dream Festival.
target: Hoc erat unum ex lucris eius ex Festival Somniorum.

source: Despite not obtaining the Beyonder characteristics of Reaza and Maslow, and the mysterious disappearance of the man and woman who served the Demon, Lumian had finally acquired something of value.
target: Quamquam proprietates Beyonder Reazae et Maslow non adeptus est, atque disparitio arcana viri et feminae qui Daemoni ministrabant evenisse apparuit, Lumian tandem aliquid pretiosum adeptus erat.

source: He continued searching the area but found no other traces.
target: Continuavit regionem perquirere, sed nullas alias vestigia invenit.

source: Left with no other option, he teleported back to the second floor of the Brieu Motel.
target: Nullo alio consilio relicto, se per viam magicam ad secundum tabulatum Brieu Motel revocavit.

source: By then, much of the smoke and dust caused by the meteorite had dissipated.
target: Ad illud tempus, multus fumus et pulvis, qui a meteoro orti erant, evanuerant.

source: The crimson moon’s light cast an eerie glow over Tizamo.
target: Lux lunaris rubrae super Tizamo lumen horribilem effudit.

source: Lumian noticed a folded letter on the master bedroom’s desk, with a thin brass‑like metal sheet on top.
target: Lumian epistulam plicatam in mensa cubiculi principalis animadvertit, cui superpositum erat laminam tenuem, similem aerei.

source: Madam Magician’s response is swift tonight…
target: Responsum Dominae Magicae hac nocte celeriter accidit…

source: Lumian picked up the brass plate and examined the mysterious patterns and words etched upon it, but he couldn’t discern their meaning or purpose.
target: Lumian laminam aereum levavit et arcana figurae verbaque in ea inscripta perspexit, sed significationem aut propositum eorum discerere non potuit.

source: He couldn’t even sense the corresponding spirituality glow.
target: Neque quidem spiritualem effulgentiam corresponentem sensisse potuit.

source: Shaking his head, Lumian temporarily set aside the brass sheet.
target: Caput iactans, Lumian pro tempore laminam aeream deiecit.

source: With a gentle grab of his right hand, he conjured a floating incandescent white fireball.
target: Dextera mansuete apprehensa, globum ignis candidi, fulgenti et leviter volitantem evocavit.

source: Under its glow, he sat down and began reading Madam Magician’s reply.
target: Sub eius lumine sedebat et responsum Dominae Magicae legere inchoavit.

source: “There’s no doubt about it.”
target: “Nullum dubium de ea re est.”

source: “From what you’ve described, the corpse in the dream tomb belongs to Naboredisley.”
target: “Ex his quae narravisti, cadaver in sepulcro somniorum Naboredisley est.”

source: “As for Naboredisley, there’s a high likelihood that it’s an alias of Devil Monarch Farbauti or a real name that can be used under certain circumstances.”
target: “Quoad Naboredisley, magna verisimilitudo est eum esse pseudonymum Monarchae Diaboli Farbauti aut nomen verum, quod sub quibusdam condicionibus adhiberi possit.”

source: “Don’t you find it strange that Naboredisley, as a Devil Monarch and one of the eight ancient gods who once ruled the world, can bestow superpowers from the Prisoner pathway?”
target: “Nonne mirum censes quod Naboredisley, ut Monarcha Diaboli et unus ex octo deis antiquis, qui olim orbem terrarum regebant, vires supernaturales ex via Captivi conferre possit?”

source: “This abnormality is quite normal for the ancient gods.”
target: “Haec anomalia diis antiquis plane naturalis est.”

source: “They didn’t advance according to the paths of the divine, but were born directly for some unknown reason.”
target: “Non in semitis divinis progresērunt, sed directe nati sunt propter aliquam incognitam causam.”

source: “Their characteristics were a mix of Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics from other pathways, or even more than one.”
target: “Eorum lineamenta erant mixtura proprietatum Beyonder ex sequentia prima aliorum semitum, vel etiam plurium.”

source: “Considering Demon Warlock Burman’s situation, you can see how unhinged and violent the ancient gods were.”
target: “Considerata re Daemoni Warlock Burman, videre potes quam insaniti et violenti dii antiqui fuerint.”

source: “There’s a significant difference between ancient gods and subsequent true gods, but this doesn’t mean that They are weak. They might even be stronger.”
target: “Inter deos antiquos et deos veros posteriores discrimen notabilem est, sed hoc non significat eos infirmos esse; fortiores etiam esse possunt.”

source: “Among them, although Farbauti is the Devil Monarch, He blends in Sequence 1 Abomination from a neighboring pathway.”
target: “Inter eos, quamquam Farbauti Monarcha Diaboli est, tamen proprietates Abominationis Sequentionis 1 ex via vicina in se miscit.”

source: “Therefore, His state is one of the best among the eight ancient gods.”
target: “Itaque status eius inter optimos deorum antiquorum numeratur.”

source: “He has also become the only ancient god alive in Their original form.”
target: “Immo, factus est solus deus antiquus, in forma sua originali manens.”

source: “In fact, if Farbauti were to gather the ingredients of the Devil pathway as a Sequence 1 Abomination and complete the deity‑ascension ritual to advance, He would be equivalent to a true god now—a stronger true god.”
target: “Revera, si Farbauti ingredientia viae Diaboli ut Abominationem Sequentionis 1 congregaret et ritum deitatis ascensionis ad progrediendum perficeret, nunc aequivaleret deo vero—deo vero fortiori.”

source: “He wouldn’t be an ancient god described by words like madness, cruelty, violence, and bloodlust.”
target: “Non esset deus antiquus, ut verbis insaniae, crudelitatis, violentiae, et sanguinis cupiditatis describeretur.”

source: “Of course, as the Devil Monarch, even if He had done so, He will inevitably exhibit the characteristics of I am the Abyss, the Abyss is Me, experiencing strong influence from this pathway.”
target: “Certe, ut Monarcha Diaboli, etiamsi id fecisset, necessario ostendet proprietates, quae dicunt: ‘Abyssum sum, et abyssus est ego’, sub vehementi influentia huius viae.”

source: “As for the state of a Devil, you should be well aware.”
target: “Quoad statum Diaboli, id tibi perspicuum esse debet.”

source: “Therefore, Farbauti is also one of the two or three most unhinged ancient gods. This doesn’t contradict His better state.”
target: “Itaque Farbauti est etiam unus ex duobus aut tribus diis antiquis, maxime insanis; hoc autem non adversatur meliore statu eius.”

source: “That’s all for the ancient gods. That’s not my primary purpose in writing.”
target: “Hoc est totum quod ad deos antiquos attinet. Non hoc est propositum principale meum scriptionis.”

source: “In short, the one in the dream tomb is indeed Naboredisley, the other Naboredisley in the form of an Abomination.”
target: “In summa, qui in sepulcro somniorum residet, revera est Naboredisley, alterque Naboredisley in forma Abominationis est.”

source: “Is that so…”
target: “Ita vero…”

source: “Ancient gods possess Beyonder characteristics of neighboring or non‑neighboring pathways, and Naboredisley has already displayed the ability to separate different desires and emotions…”
target: “Dii antiqui possident proprietates Beyonder ex semitis vicinis atque remotis, et Naboredisley iam facultatem demonstravit diversas cupiditates et affectus separandi.”

source: “Lumian no longer harbored any doubts about the cold corpse’s ability to bestow Wraith powers.”
target: “Lumian iam de facultate cadaveris frigidi ad largitionem virium umbratium non dubitabat.”

source: “After some thought, he reread Madam Magician’s letter.”
target: “Post aliquam cogitationem, epistulam Dominae Magicae iterum legit.”

source: “You mentioned that Naboredisley took the initiative to lie back in the dream tomb and continue in a dead state.”
target: “Dixisti Naboredisley initium cepisse, ut in sepulcro somniorum recubaret et in statu mortuo perseveraret.”

source: “This is a very rational choice for Him.”
target: “Hoc est electio prorsus rationalis pro eo.”

source: “Furthermore, I must say it’s a good death.”
target: “Praeterea, fateor mortem bonam esse.”

source: “Continue in this dead state until after the apocalypse!”
target: “Persevera in hoc statu mortuo usque ad post apocalypsim!”

source: “You don’t need to know the exact reason.”
target: “Non opus est tibi causam exactam noscere.”

source: “To put it simply, you can see that Naboredisley, or the Devil Monarch Farbauti, is in a terrible state.”
target: “Dicendum simpliciter, videre potes Naboredisley, vel Monarcham Diaboli Farbauti, in terribili statu esse.”

source: “As an Abomination, His demise is more suitable than Him living.”
target: “Ut Abominatione, mors eius potius quam vita eius idonea est.”

source: “It’s better for both Him and this world.”
target: “Utrumque ei atque huic mundo melius est.”

source: “Of course, this can’t be a simple death.”
target: “Certe, hoc non potest esse mors simplex.”

source: “He chose a good place to die.”
target: “Locum bonum ad mortem eliguit.”

source: “This will allow His corpse to enjoy peace and tranquility, safe from the Mother Tree of Desire’s harassment.”
target: “Hoc sinet cadaver eius pacem ac tranquillitatem frui, ab vexatione Arboris Matris Desiderii immuniter.”

source: “Now, you should understand.”
target: “Nunc debes intellegere.”

source: “That entity had written a story and created a coincidence, allowing you to come into contact with Naboredisley in the Feynapotter Kingdom.”
target: “Ea entitas fabulam scripserat et casum creaverat, ita ut tibi in Regno Feynapotter cum Naboredisley convenire liceat.”

source: “Then, you went to Hanth Island and the New City of Silver.”
target: “Deinde ad Insulam Hanth et Novam Urbem Argenteam ivisti.”

source: “His goal was to send information to Naboredisley in the dream ancient tomb, allowing Him to continue sleeping and be a corpse instead of being resurrected.”
target: “Propositum eius erat nuntium ad Naboredisley in sepulcro antiquo somniorum mittendi, ut ei liceat pergere dormire et cadaver manere potius quam resurgere.”

source: “Simultaneously, this also prevents various factions from trying to obtain the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic.”
target: “Simul, hoc etiam impediat varias factiones proprietatem Beyonder Sequentionis 1 exquirere.”

source: “Tsk, as expected of a remnant from ancient times.”
target: “Tsk, ut ex reliquis antiquitatis exspectabatur.”

source: “He’s the protagonist who personally ended the rule of the ancient gods.”
target: “Ipse est protagonista, qui ipse finem imposuit regni deorum antiquorum.”

source: “The secrets and various key matters He knows perhaps exceed all of us combined.”
target: “Arcana et varia puncta clavis, quae scit, fortasse omnium nostrum numerum superant.”

source: “Apart from Him and the Evernight Goddess, who else would know about mysticism festivals like the Dream Festival, which you forget when you wake up?”
target: “Praeter illum et Deam Sempernocturnam, quis alibi sciret de festivitatibus mysticis, ut Festum Somniorum, quas cum evigilabis oblivisceris?”

source: “Who would have thought that the corpse was part of the Devil Monarch?”
target: “Quis putasset cadaver esse partem Monarchae Diaboli?”

source: “The substantial digestion of the Reaper potion, the acquisition of the golden mask, and the formation of the corroded soil should be the rewards He promised.”
target: “Substantialis digestio potionis Messoris, acquisitio larvæ aureæ, et formatio soli corrosi debent esse praemia quae promisit.”

source: “Remember to give me that corroded soil.”
target: “Memento mihi illud solum corrosum tradere.”

source: “It’s useless to you, but I can help you exchange it for something.”
target: “Tibi inutilis est, sed possum te adiuvare ut illud in aliquid commutas.”

source: “It might also present an opportunity, but I can’t discern what it is for now.”
target: “Fortasse etiam opportunitatem praebere potest, sed nunc quidnam id propositum sit, discerere non possum.”

source: “And with that golden mask, you can boldly venture into the Underworld when the opportunity arises in the future.”
target: “Et cum illa larva aurea, audacter in Inferos progredere potes, cum occasio futura apparuerit.”

source: “Otherwise, the living won’t be able to stay in the Underworld for even a second.”
target: “Alioquin, vivi ne quidem per momentum in Inferos manere poterunt.”

source: “Those golden masks come from the fallen Death, the ancestor of the Eggers family.”
target: “Illae larvæ aureae proveniunt ex morte lapsa, maiori familiae Eggers.”

source: “They were originally created to assist Death’s direct descendants in entering and exiting the Underworld and Death’s kingdom.”
target: “Primitivē creatae sunt ut directi posteri Mortis in ingressu atque egressu Inferorum et regni Mortis adiuvare queant.”

source: “Their purpose is twofold.”
target: “Propositum eorum dupliciter se habet.”

source: “Firstly, to protect the wearer from the corrosion of the aura of death.”
target: “Primum, ut indutorem a corrosione aurae mortis protegat.”

source: “Secondly, to transform the wearer into an undead creature.”
target: “Secundo, ut indutorem in creaturam mortuorum convertat.”

source: “Their bodies no longer have vital points, while their minds and consciousness can maintain their living state.”
target: “Corporibus eorum puncta vitalia iam non sunt, dum mentes atque conscientia statum vivantem retinere possunt.”

source: “Do you understand why Naboredisley’s corpse wore the Death mask?”
target: “Intelligisne cur cadaver Naboredisley larvam Mortis indutus sit?”

source: “If it didn’t, it would have died completely in the dream tomb, with no possibility of revival.”
target: “Si id non fuisset, omnino in sepulcro somniorum mortuus esset, nec ulla spes reviviscendi existeret.”

source: “Similarly, knowing the golden mask’s functions and the state of the corpse, you should understand why Hisoka put on the golden mask.”
target: “Similiter, cum scias munus larvæ aureæ et statum cadaveris, debes intelligere cur Hisoka larvam auream indutus sit.”

source: “It allows a corpse to mistake Hisoka for one of its kind without affecting him.”
target: “Hoc cadaveri sinit ut Hisokam pro suo simile confundat, sine quo illud afficere valeat.”

source: “It also protects Hisoka from the corrosion of the tomb’s aura of death.”
target: “Praeterea, Hisokam ab corrosione aurae Mortis sepulcri protegit.”

source: “The first phantom that experienced an Ascension activated the corpse’s sleeping spirit under the golden mask’s protection, but without awakening His consciousness.”
target: “Primum phantasma, quae ascensionem passa est, sub tutela larvæ aureæ spiritum dormientem cadaveris excitavit, sed non conscientiam eius evigilavit.”

source: “In this state, Hisoka can use his resemblance to the corpse to make the corpse mistake him for its spirit and accept his dominance.”
target: “In hoc statu, Hisoka similitudinem suam ad cadaver referre potest, ut cadaver eum pro spiritu eius existimet atque dominationem accipiat.”

source: “Isn’t this style familiar?”
target: “Nonne hic modus tibi notus est?”

source: “That Celestial Worthy is indeed the strongest god who seeks out errors and exploits loopholes.”
target: “Ille Caelestis Dignus est vere fortissimus deus, qui errores quaerit et ambages perlustrare vult.”

source: “By the time the second phantom that underwent Ascension entered the dream ancient tomb, the corpse’s consciousness would have been basically awakened.”
target: “Cum secundum phantasma, qui ascensionem passa est, in sepulcrum antiquam somniorum intrasset, conscientia cadaveris fere evigilata esset.”

source: “Even if Hisoka were still alive, he wouldn’t be able to complete his grand plan.”
target: “Etiam si Hisoka adhuc vivesse, magnum consilium suum perficere non posset.”

source: “That’s the gist of the matter.”
target: “Hoc est res summatim.”

source: “The Numinous Episcopate’s purpose is the ancient tomb itself, the golden mask that has endured the corresponding corrosion in the tomb for over a millennium.”
target: “Propositum Episcopatus Numinous est ipsum sepulcrum antiquum, larva aurea, quae corrosionem insepulta per ultra mille annos pertulit.”

source: “The Nois family’s archduke, a collaborator of the Rose School of Thought, desires Naboredisley’s corpse, while the temperance faction seeks to retrieve Miss Messenger’s heart.”
target: “Archidux familiae Nois, collaborans cum Schola Rosae Rationis, cadaver Naboredisley desiderat, dum factio temperantiae cor Dominae Messenger restituere conatur.”

source: “Their goals were actually different, yet they fought to the death.”
target: “Proposita eorum revera diversa erant, sed ad mortem pugnaverunt.”

source: “I have to say, it’s quite humorous and ironic.”
target: “Fateor, hoc valde iocundum et ironicum est.”

source: “Of course, this is mainly because they can’t trust each other, and there’s indeed a possibility that it’s a situation where the winner takes all.”
target: “Certe, hoc maxime est propter quod inter se confidere non possunt, et revera possit esse res in qua victor omnia decernit.”

source: “Does Miss Messenger want to consume Naboredisley’s Abomination body?”
target: “Num Domina Messenger vult consumere corpus Abominationis Naboredisley?”

source: “Of course She does!”
target: “Certe, illa vult!”

source: “Miss Messenger… The lady who used the lucky gold coin to buy the heart from Ludwig?”
target: “Domina Messenger… ea femina, quae fortunato auro nummo cor a Ludovico comparavit?”

source: “Why is she called Miss Messenger?”
target: “Cur illa Domina Messenger vocatur?”

source: “It’s impossible for Her to be someone’s messenger, right?”
target: “Non potest fieri ut illa nuntia alicuius sit, nonne?”

source: “She’s an Angel!”
target: “Ea est angelica!”

source: “Uh… Mr. Fool’s messenger?”
target: “Heu... nuntia Domini Stulti?”

source: “So that’s why there’s a lucky gold coin closely related to Mr. Fool…”
target: “Itaque ideo nummus aureus fortunatus, qui arcte Domino Stulto coniungitur, existit...”

source: “Lumian was sharp, and he quickly made a guess.”
target: “Lumian acutus erat, et celeriter coniecturam fecit.”

source: “He continued reading the last part of the letter.”
target: “Continuavit ultimam partem epistolae legere.”

source: “I forgot to mention that wearing that golden mask also poses problems.”
target: “Oblitus sum mentionem facere quod indutio illae larvæ aureæ etiam problemata afferat.”

source: “As you can imagine, once you transform into an undead creature and don’t have any vital points on your body, the purification of sunlight and lightning will be fatal to you.”
target: “Ut te ipsum possis imaginari, cum in creaturam mortuorum convertearis et puncta vitalia in corpore tuo deessent, purificatio solis ac fulminis tibi fatale erit.”

source: “Moreover, if a living person wears that golden mask for too long, they will truly become deceased.”
target: “Porro, si persona viva illam larvam auream per longum tempus gerit, vere mortuus erit.”

source: “When that time comes, once the mask is removed, their mind and consciousness will be unprotected and they will die immediately.”
target: “Cum tempus illud adveniet, et larva sublata erit, mens ac conscientia eorum non erunt protegenda, atque statim morientur.”

source: “Let me see what else I haven’t mentioned…”
target: “Videamus quid alia non memoravi…”

source: “Yes, you said that the Underworld Daoist and Naboredisley’s corpse had looked at Iveljsta Eggers without doing anything to him.”
target: “Ita, dixisti Taoista Inferorum et cadaver Naboredisley in Iveljsta Eggers aspexisse, nihil ei factum esse.”

source: “That gave me some ideas.”
target: “Id mihi nonnullas cogitationes excitavit.”

source: “It’s highly likely that the one who helped bury Naboredisley’s Abomination corpse and construct the dream grave was the ancestor of the Eggers family, the deceased Death.”
target: “Verisimile est eum, qui adiuvit cadaver Abominationis Naboredisley sepelire et sepulcrum somniorum construere, fuisse maiora familiae Eggers, Mortem defunctum.”

source: “After He went mad, perhaps He interacted with the Underworld Daoist, who guarded the river and the Blood Emperor’s afterimage.”
target: “Postquam insanivit, fortasse commutavit cum Taoista Inferorum, qui flumen et vestigia Imperatoris Sanguinis custodiebat.”

source: “And for some reason, He agreed to Naboredisley’s request for help, causing His Abomination corpse to slumber in a special dream.”
target: “Et, quacumque ratione, consensit auxilium petendum a Naboredisley, quo cadaver eius Abominationis in somnio peculiare obdormiret.”

source: “Therefore, be it the Underworld Daoist or Naboredisley’s corpse, even if they only have their instincts left, they will still treat the Eggers family’s bloodline specially.”
target: “Unde, sive Taoista Inferorum sive cadaver Naboredisley sit, etiam si solum vestigia instinctuum remanent, tamen peculiari modo tractabunt sanguineam genealogiam familiae Eggers.”
